claims.claim: The item is a Canon EOS 5D Mark II DSLR camera body.
claims.evidence: Witness report photo 0 shows Canon logo and “EOS 5D Mark II” marking.

claims.claim: The Canon EOS 5D Mark II has a 21.1-megapixel full-frame sensor.
claims.evidence: No photo evidence of sensor specs; only the model marking is shown.

risks.risk: Shutter count/usage history unknown; high actuation can reduce value.
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo of the shutter count from-camera or via a shutter-count utility (e.g., EXIF/shutter count readout).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used body with unknown shutter count (worst-case within typical used range).

risks.risk: Sensor condition unknown (dust, scratches, fungus) which affects image quality.
risks.proof: A close-up test shot of a blank surface at high f-stop (e.g., f/16–f/22) plus a photo of the sensor/cleaning status if available.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially needing sensor cleaning/with unknown sensor condition.

risks.risk: LCD functionality unknown (dead pixels, lines, brightness issues).
risks.proof: A short video/clip showing the LCD displaying live view and menus clearly (no flicker/lines).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as LCD condition unknown (worst-case: may have display issues).

risks.risk: All buttons/ports may not work (USB/HDMI/AV, buttons around LCD, AF-ON).
risks.proof: A clip showing navigation through menus and a quick connection test (USB to PC or HDMI to monitor) with visible output.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unverified functionality for controls/ports.

risks.risk: Battery/charger not included or battery health poor; camera may not power reliably.
risks.proof: Photo of included battery and charger, plus a clip showing the camera powering on and holding charge during a short recording/session.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as body-only with unknown battery/charger situation.

risks.risk: No lens included (photos show only the camera body); value depends heavily on body-only vs kit.
risks.proof: A clear photo showing what is included in the deal (lens present or explicitly not included).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as camera body only (no lens).

risks.risk: Physical damage not visible from the shown angles (dents, cracks, worn grips).
risks.proof: Full 360° photos: front, back, left/right sides, top, bottom, and close-ups of grip and mount for cracks/dents.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as condition unknown with potential cosmetic wear.

risks.risk: Memory card presence unknown; affects immediate usability.
risks.proof: Photo showing included memory card (brand/capacity) or confirmation it is not included.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming no memory card included.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of everything included (body only vs any accessories: battery, charger, strap, body cap, cables, manuals).
Send a close-up of the sensor (or a high-f-stop dust test shot) to assess dust/fungus/scratches.
Send a short video showing LCD live view + menu navigation (no dead pixels/lines).
Send a shutter count readout (screenshot/photo from a tool or in-camera/EXIF-based method).
Send a clip showing the camera powers on and functions (AF-ON response, basic shooting, and playback).
Send full 360° condition photos including grip, mount area, and any cracks/dents.
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies the camera model as a Canon EOS 5D Mark II body, so it can be priced at its worst-case used-body scenario; key functional and condition risks remain unproven but do not prevent a conservative valuation.
